pages.text: The core screen shows stored and maximum OP, energy coming $(2)in$() and going $(c)out$() per tick, the $(l)net$() rate, and how long until the core is full or empty at the current rate.$(br2)With $(item)Jade$() installed, looking at the core, a pylon sphere or a Stabilizer shows the same numbers without opening anything. Hold Shift for in/out and the time estimate.

pages.title: History and problems
pages.text: The graph button next to the eye opens a panel with the net rate over the last 5 minutes, one bar every 5 seconds: green bars fill the core, red bars drain it.$(br2)While a core is not built correctly, the screen says how many blocks are wrong. Hover over that line to see where they are and what each spot needs.

pages.title: Effects and safety
pages.text: The eye button on the core screen hides the core, stabilizer and pylon effects for you only; the blocks keep working. The client config value $(l)blockEffectRenderDistance$() limits how far away they are drawn.$(br2)$(c)Never move a core with AE2 Spatial IO$(): the core, stabilizers and pylons are marked as unmovable for that reason.
